description: Run an action, or a Simulation::MonteCarlo analysis case, a number of times (the RunRuns RPC, the CLI's -runs/-observe, the REPL's %runs): every run is an ordinary run in a context of its own, drawing its modeled randomness from a seed derived from `seed`. `rows` is the table, one row per run with the run number as its input and what it observed as its outputs; `distributions` summarises each observable over the completed runs (extremes, mean, deviation, percentiles, histogram, or the count of each distinct value); for a case `outputs` and `verdicts` are its conclusion over the sample and `unconcluded` why it has none. A run that failed is its row's error. The result is the RunRunsResponse as protojson writes it.

actionSymbolId.description: qualified name of the action to run; give this or analysisSymbolId

analysisSymbolId.description: qualified name of the Simulation::MonteCarlo analysis case, definition or usage; give this or actionSymbolId

arguments.description: positional values for the case's in parameters, each a protojson Value

clockStep.description: clock step of each run; 0 keeps the default (-clock-step)

draws.description: draw policy for the model's distributions: random (the default), min, max or average (-draws)

engine.description: the analysis engine asked, as list_engines names them; empty is auto

inputs.description: the action's input parameter name to value, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

namedArguments.description: values for the case's in parameters by name, each a protojson Value

observe.description: features of the action each run reports, clock for the time it completed at; empty reports every feature and the clock (-observe). Not for a case, which observes what it declares

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

performerSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage, or a path from one, whose object performs the action; empty performs it outside any object

runs.description: how many runs to make (-runs); positive

seed.description: seed the runs draw their modeled randomness from, one derived seed per run; required unless draws is min, max or average

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

subjectSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage to instantiate as the case's subject, or a path from one to a nested object

name: run_runs
